What I confirmed directly:
- I curled the arXiv v2 HTML and grepped it. Morwani et al. Theorem 7 (Sec. 4) covers prime p>2, width m>=4(p-1) and the neuron (u_a+v_b)^2 w. It states verbatim: maximum L_{2,3}-margin gamma* = sqrt(2/27)*1/(p^{1/2}(p-1)).
- The same theorem gives single-frequency neurons with phase condition theta_u+theta_v=theta_w, and every frequency 1..(p-1)/2 used.
- The arXiv abs page confirms the bib fields; its comment reads "Accepted as Spotlight at ICLR 2024". The OpenReview page was bot-blocked.

Independent check of the constant:
- 2B_p p/(p-1) = 4(6p)^{-3/2} p/(p-1) = sqrt(2/27)/(p^{1/2}(p-1)).
- Rederived from Morwani App. F eq. (8): one frequency at |u^|=|v^|=|w^|=sqrt(p/6).
- Agrees to 2e-16 at p=3, 5, 7, 113, 1009.

The C_3=2B_p argument is valid:
- The upper bound C_3<=2B_p comes from the power neuron via Thm universal.
- The lower bound comes from Morwani's attainment at some width. C_3 is width-free, so one width is enough.

- (a) Add [Theorem~7] and 'attained at width m>=4(p-1)' in cor:dense and app:dense.
- (b) At approach.tex:11, eta_{u,v,w}(delta) is defined in Morwani Appendix F.1, not the main text, so a pinpoint [Appendix~F.1] would help.
